contexts.text: One came to me... and asked to be alone with me... I then perceived that he was an assassin...

On two or three occasions, a cadaverous odour blew on me, and when I inquired from whom it came, I was told that it was from a Hell where there are filthy robbers, and assassins, and those who have committed wicked deeds with grievous deceit. AC 7161:3.
On the Hell of poisoners, assassins, and murderers. General article.
A cadaverous stench is most delightful to those Infernals who have been assassins and poisoners...
